author: GitHub
description:
Open source maintainers are facing an influx of low-quality contributions across their repositories. In this episode of The GitHub Podcast, Cassidy and GPS sit down with Camilla Moraes, product manager on GitHub's Maintainer Love team, to talk about how her team builds high-impact tools for maintainers. Learn how new features like PR limits help manage spam and how Camilla uses Copilot CLI to organize qualitative maintainer feedback.
